    BuildingDoubleInventor.applyOnCharacterPicked(Player p, Game g, BuildingCard card, CharacterCard newCharacter)

    Upon the arrival of a new character, checks if every job reaches the quota of the newly incremented job; if the set is complete, credits 5 food.
    void

    Adds the configured aura bonus to the player's score.
    void
    BuildingJobAuraBonus.applyOnEndGame(Player p, Game g, BuildingCard card)
    At the end of the game, credits aura based on characters of the configured job: either by summing their base aura (useCardBaseAura), or by multiplying their number by the building's multiplier.
    void
    BuildingSixDifferentAura.applyOnEndGame(Player p, Game g, BuildingCard card)
    At the end of the game, awards 6 aura for each complete set of the six different jobs: the number of sets equals the least represented job in the tribe.
    void
    BuildingEventCostModifier.applyOnEvent(Player p, Game g, BuildingCard card, EventCard currentEvent)
    Sets temporary modifiers on the player which are then read by the event effect: food discount on Sustenance (for their own job), or extra food/aura on Hunting/Cave Paintings events when the event matches the building type.
    void
    BuildingShamanPassive.applyOnEvent(Player p, Game g, BuildingCard card, EventCard currentEvent)
    Sets temporary shields on the player which are then read by the Shamanic Ritual event: immunity to aura loss and/or doubling of the bonus.
    void
    BuildingImmediateResource.applyOnPurchase(Player p, Game g, BuildingCard card)
    Credits the configured aura and magic to the player at the time of purchase.
    void
    BuildingExtraPick.applyOnTurnEnd(Player p, Game g, BuildingCard card)
    Activates the extra pick flag on the player at the end of the turn.
    void
    BuildingTurnOrderBonus.applyOnTurnEnd(Player p, Game g, BuildingCard card)
    At the end of the turn, if the player occupies a turn order slot with a positive food bonus, credits them with 1 additional food.

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    EventArtist.applyOnEvent(Player p, Game g, EventCard ec, EventCard currentEvent)
    For each player compares the number of artists with the event threshold: below threshold applies the aura penalty, from the threshold up credits artists * multiplier; finally resets temporary modifiers.
    void
    EventFarmer.applyOnEvent(Player p, Game g, EventCard ec, EventCard currentEvent)
    For each player calculates the sustenance cost (1 per card in tribe), subtracts the gatherers discount (×3) and the buildings discount, and applies the cost: if the food is insufficient, converts the missing part into aura loss.
    void
    EventHunter.applyOnEvent(Player p, Game g, EventCard ec, EventCard currentEvent)
    For each player credits food and aura proportional to the number of hunters (plus temporary building bonuses), then resets temporary modifiers.
    void
    EventShaman.applyOnEvent(Player p, Game g, EventCard ec, EventCard currentEvent)
    Calculates the maximum and minimum magic points among the players: the one at the maximum gains the bonus (doubled if they have the "double aura" building and are the only one at the maximum), the one at the minimum suffers the malus (unless "no loss"); then resets the temporary modifiers.

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    SetUpGameState.chooseTotemColor(Game game, String nickname, String color)
    Assigns the totem color to a player, validating that the color exists and has not already been chosen by another player.
    void
    PickingState.endTurn(Game game, String nickname)
    Voluntarily ends the player's picking turn.
    void
    PickingState.handleDisconnection(Game game, Player p, boolean isCurrentPlayer)
    Handles the disconnection of a NON-turn player who had an occupied tile: frees it, moves them to the bottom of the turn order and notifies the totem return (the turn player continues picking undisturbed).
    void
    StartTurnState.handleDisconnection(Game game, Player p, boolean isCurrentPlayer)
    Handles the disconnection of a player during the placement phase: frees the offering tile if they had occupied it, removes them from the turn order compacting the others, and if it was their turn passes to the next.
    void
    EndGameState.joinGame(Game game, String nickname)
    A new entry after the game is over starts a NEW game: clears the players, resets the state to SetUpGameState and forwards the join to the setup.
    void
    SetUpGameState.joinGame(Game game, String nickname)
    Adds a new player to the lobby, verifying that the room is not full (max 5) and that the nickname is not already in use.
    void
    PickingState.pickCard(Game game, String nickname, String row, int cardIndex)
    Executes the drawing of a card by the current player.
    void
    StartTurnState.placeTotem(Game game, String nickname, int offerPosition)
    Places the turn player's totem on a free offering tile.
    Player
    PickingState.recoverActivePlayer(Game game)
    After a crash recovery, identifies the player who is picking (the first occupant of the offering track not yet returned to the turn order).
    Player
    StartTurnState.recoverActivePlayer(Game game)
    After a crash recovery, identifies the player who has yet to act in this phase (the first in the turn order who hasn't placed the totem).
    void
    EndGameState.resolvePhase(Game game)
    Resolves the final phase of the game: applies the remaining final events and the endgame effects of the buildings, records the aura delta produced, calculates the winners and notifies the clients.
    void
    EventState.resolvePhase(Game game)
    Automatically resolves the end-of-round event phase: applies building triggers and resolves all event cards in order, then reorganizes the board (discards/moves rows, refills, handles possible Era transition), advances the round, resets the totems and finally transitions to StartTurnState.
    void
    SetUpGameState.setupGame(Game game)
    Starts the game: requires at least 2 players and that everyone has chosen a color, then delegates to Game.setupGame() the construction of decks and board and finally transitions to the StartTurnState.
    void
    PickingState.skipTurn(Game game, String nickname)
    Skips the picking turn of the current player (e.g. disconnected): closes their pick returning the totem, applies the end-of-turn building effects and advances the phase (next picker, or transition to Event/EndGame if picking is complete).
    void
    StartTurnState.skipTurn(Game game, String nickname)
    Skips the current player's turn (e.g. disconnected): moves them to the bottom of the turn order, marks them as "has placed" and passes to the next.
